title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 104
paragraphs: With these sons he sent Hermotimos to take charge of them, a man of the Pedasan race who, in the king's estimation, was second to none of the eunuchs. (The Pedasians dwell above Halicarnassus, and at this Pedasa a thing happens as follows: whenever some trouble is about to come upon the whole number of those who dwell around the city within a certain time, then the priestess of Athena there grows a long beard. This has happened to them twice before now.
